Commentary.Commentary: Right. That is all we have from this game. We have enjoyed bringing the coverage of this series and we hope you have had fun too. The playoffs in the Indian T20 League are coming up next and the T20 World Cup is lined up as well. Check out our fixture pages to know when all the games go down. Cheers!
Aqib Ilyas is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH.

Earlier in the day, Oman were put into bat and they responded well by scoring 159 runs. Sri Lanka started the chase well but lost wickets in cluster in the middle overs. There was heavy dew on the ground which made things difficult for Oman bowlers and they failed to defend the score. As a result, Sri Lanka sealed the series 2-0.

Oman did leak some runs at the start of the innings but they came back well and chipped wickets at regular intervals. The spinners did go for plenty of runs but Mohammad Nadeem and Kaleemullah bowled well and kept Sri Lanka's batters in check. At one point, they were certainly in the driver's seat but they were not able to keep up the good work and the match drifted from the hosts. Oman bowlers fought hard but the excessive dew on the field didn't help them at all.

Sri Lanka did come out to bat with intent as Dinesh Chandimal got off to a great start but he could not carry on and was dismissed for 18. His opening partner, Pathum Nissanka also batted well but just as he was looking up the ante he perished and it was up to Sri Lanka's middle-order batters to tale their team through. The visitors had a collapse in the middle overs where they lost 3 wickets in a space of 8 balls and were in deep trouble. It was Chamika Karunaratne and Bhanuka Rajapaksa who got together and they ensured that there were no further hiccups. In the end, Sri Lanka managed to cross the line, thanks to some sensible batting by these two.

Sri Lanka have sealed the series 2-0 and they would be very pleased with this effort going into the T20 World Cup. Oman gave it their all but in the end they fell short and they would be a touch disappointed as at one point they had a good chance to run away with this game.

SIX! There is the winning hit! Chamika Karunaratne has played a good knock to see his side home. This is the slower ball, around off and middle, Chamika Karunaratne gets low, waits for the ball to arrive and then thumps this one over deep square leg, over the leaping fielder for a biggie. SRI LANKA WIN BY 5 WICKETS!
On a fullish length, way outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa reaches out and punches this one through point. They take one. 3 more needed!
Kaleemullah is back now.
Fuller this time, around off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa steps out and smacks this through mid off and complete two runs. 4 more needed now.
SIX! Great shot. Just 6 more needed now! Short-of-a-length delivery, width offered outside off, Chamika Karunaratne stands tall and flat-bats this one over the long off region for a biggie.
On a length, around off and middle this time, Bhanuka Rajapaksa works this past mid-wicket for one.
Short of a length, around off and middle, Chamika Karunaratne looks to pull but miscues this towards short mid-wicket for a single.
This is hurled short and on the body, pulled down to fine leg for one.
A couple now! Fuller again, on off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa works this through mid on and runs hard to come back for the second.
Fuller, around middle, played through mid on for a run.
Loopy ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne defends it to backward point for another single.
A single now, as this is worked to long on.
Full and on off. Chamika Karunaratne pushes it to cover for a single.
Flatter and outside off. Rajapaksa cuts it to backward point for a run.
SIX! BANG! Bhanuka Rajapaksa makes the most of the Free Hit. Quicker, full and outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa leans in and powers it over the long off fence for a maximum.

NO BALL AND BYE! There is a lot of dew on the ball and the bowler could not keep the ball in control. The ball goes over the batter's head, it even passes the keeper. The umpire signals a no ball. The ball sneak a bye. Free Hit to follow.
Floated, full and on off. Chamika Karunaratne defends it to cover.
Full toss and on off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Full and on off. Karunaratne pushes it to mid off for a run.
Fuller and outside off. Chamika Karunaratne looks to push it out but misses. The ball rolls out off the pads. Khan appeals but the umpire says no.
Yorker, on middle and leg. Bhanuka Rajapaksa digs it to long on for a single.
NO BALL AND SIX! A full toss, above waist height, on the bodyline. Bhanuka Rajapaksa hangs back and smokes it over the square leg fence for a maximum. No ball called and a Free Hit is coming up.
LEG BYE! Touch short, on the bodyline. Chamika Karunaratne looks to pull it away but misses. The ball hits the body and rolls to the leg side. The batters collect a leg bye.
Low full toss, on off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa pushes it towards long on for a single.
Bilal Khan comes back into the attack.
A length ball, on off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa guides it to third man for a single.
A length ball, on off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Bangs in another short ball, on middle. Chamika Karunaratne hangs back and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Short ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne looks to hook it away but misses.
Good-length ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
In the air...Safe! A length ball, outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa lifts it towards long on. The ball lands safely. The batters pick three before the fielder cuts it off.
Full and on off. Chamika Karunaratne pushes it to mid off.
A length ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne flicks it through mid-wicket. The man in the deep misfields and the batters pick up two in total.
SIX! All the way! A full-length ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne gets under it and lifts it over the long off fence for a maximum.
On a length, on off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa taps it to cover and takes off for a single.

CLOSE! A length ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne pushes it to the off side. The bowler chases, collects the ball, but he misses his shy at the striker's end. If the wickets were hit, the batsman was a goner.
A length ball, on middle. Karunaratne tucks it to short mid-wicket.

Short, around middle and leg, pulled behind square on the leg side. The man in the deep slides near the ropes and pulls it back. There is an overthrow too as the batters take one more. Three taken in total. 62 needed in 48 balls!
A touch short, outside off, slashed hard through point for a run.
WIDE. Full toss, way outside off, the shot is missed by BR. Wided.
Slower delivery, around off, knocked to long on for one.
Chamika Karunaratne finally gets off the mark! Fuller in length, outside off, driven crisply through covers and a couple of runs are taken.
Back of a length, around off, CK dabs this one towards point.
Bhanuka Rajapaksa rotates the strike as he pushes this to point. They look for two but they do not go for it in the end. A good decision.
Fayyaz Ahmed comes back to bowl.
Yes, it is! Around off, Chamika Karunaratne defends it back to the bowler.
Another dot! Can this be a double-wicket maiden? Short, around off, tapped to cover-point.
Around off, punched to the mid off fielder now.
Chamika Karunaratne walks out to bat now.

OUT! EDGED AND CAUGHT! Nadeem gets his second wicket and Shanaka goes back for a 2-ball duck. Oman are looking hungry and are doing so well to take regular wickets. Back of a length, around off, the ball lands and shapes away. Dasun Shanaka has a poke at this tentatively and the outside edge is induced. The keeper, Naseem Khushi gobbles this up. 71 needed in 57 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Naseem Khushi b Mohammad Nadeem

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, worked to mid-wicket.
Dasun Shanaka walks out to bat.

OUT! LBW! Mohammad Nadeem gets gold on his very first ball! Avishka Fernando was looking solid but his inning has come to a sorry end. Nadeem serves this one a length, around middle and leg, Avishka Fernando misses his tuck to the leg side and gets thudded on his pad. An appeal and the umpire raises his finger.
Mohammad Nadeem comes into the attack.
A single to end a good over for Oman. On middle, whipped through mid-wicket for one. 71 needed in 60 balls!
Back of a length, around off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa opens his account by tapping this through covers.
Short and on the body, the pull is missed by Bhanuka Rajapaksa and he is hit on the body.
Around off, defended out.
Bhanuka Rajapaksa is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Oman get a wicket here and Kaleemullah has struck! He serves a slower delivery, back-of-the-hand delivery, around off and middle, Pathum Nissanka gets deceived by this as he looks to clip but does so early and misses. Gets hit on the pads and an appeal is put in. The umpire does not take long to raise his finger. 73 needed in 64 balls!
Short, around off, Pathum Nissanka stands tall and hammers this to deep mid-wicket. A fumble in the deep and the batters are able to come back for the second.
WIDE. This was the slower one, down the leg side, left alone.
Kaleemullah comes back to bowl.
Flighted, outside off, driven nicely to sweeper cover for one. 19 off the over. 76 needed in 66 balls.
Avishka Fernando gets forward and taps this to point for an easy run.
Fuller again, outside off, hit through covers for one more.
A single now as this is played through covers.
SIX! THAT IS OUT OF HERE! The Free Hit has been dispatched by Fernando! Loopy, around off, fuller too, Avishka Fernando just pumps this one over the deep mid-wicket fence.

NO BALL AND SIX! What a great outcome for Sri Lanka! Fuller, around off, tossed up, Avishka Fernando stands tall and thumps this one over the bowler's head for a biggie. A no ball called as Zeeshan Maqsood had overstepped. Free Hit coming up.
On middle, Avishka Fernando plays this through mid off and comes back for the second.
Darted on the pads, Fernando tucks it to wide long on for a single. A good over for Sri Lanka. 13 runs coming off it.
WIDE! Floated and down leg. Fernando leaves it alone. Wide called.
On middle, nudged to mid on for a single.
SIX! ALL THE WAY! A much-needed boundary. Short and on off. Fernando stands tall and muscles it over the long on fence for a maximum.
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Fernando works it to long on for a single.
Loopy ball, on off. Nissanka pushes it to cover for a single.
Flatter and outside off. Nissanka cuts it to cover.
Ayaan Khan comes into the attack.
On middle, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted and on off. Nissanka gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On off, pushed to cover for a single.
Full and on off. Fernando plays it back to the bowler.
Full and on middle. Nissanka tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Floated and on off. Fernando hangs back and works it to mid on for a single.

Slower, length ball, on the pads. Nissanka looks to defend it out but misses. He gets rapped on his pads. Kaleemullah puts in an appeal, he keeps approaching towards the umpire, but the umpire is unmoved.
Short and outside off. Nissanka hangs back and cuts it through point for a couple.
WIDE! Slower, length ball, down leg. Nissanka looks to pull it away but misses. Wide called.
Touch short and on off. Fernando hangs back and taps it to point for a run.
Slower, full and on the pads. Nissanka clips it to square leg for another single.
A length ball, on middle. Fernando flicks it to square leg for a single.
BEAUTY! That is a ripper. Good-length ball, on off. The ball gets an extra bounce off the pitch. Fernando looks to defend it out but misses. The ball zips past the outside edge.
Kaleemullah comes back to bowl.
On the pads, flicked to square leg for a run.
Full and on middle. Nissanka works it to mid on for a single.
Flatter and on off. Nissanka tucks it to short mid-wicket.
On off, pushed to covers.
Avishka Fernando walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! The skipper comes into the attack and does not take time to get into the wicket's column. This is what the doctor ordered for Oman. The second wicket falls now. Floated, full and on off. Charith Asalanka gets under it and lifts it towards long off. Fayyaz Ahmed runs back, keeps his eyes on the ball and takes a really good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Fayyaz Ahmed b Zeeshan Maqsood

Commentary.Commentary: Loopy ball, Charith Asalanka whips it across the line towards long on for a couple.
Zeeshan Maqsood to bowl now.
Change.
Good-length ball, shaping away from off. Pathum Nissanka blocks it towards backward point.
Length ball, around off. Pathum Nissanka prods and pushes it to mid on.
Good-length ball, on middle. Pathum Nissanka tucks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! EDGY! Short ball, around off. Pathum Nissanka looks to pull but it takes the top edge and the ball flies over the keeper for a boundary.
Length ball, around off. Charith Asalanka heaves it over the mid on fielder. The fielder gives it a chase and keeps it to two. There is a misfield at the bowler's end and the batters take one more.
TWO LEG BYES! Length ball, down leg. Charith Asalanka misses his flick and the ball hits him on the pads. It rolls behind and they take two.
FOUR! SHOT! Banged into the deck, around off. Pathum Nissanka hangs back and whips it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Back of a length, on middle and leg. Pathum Nissanka tucks it to mid-wicket.
Charith Asalanka walks out now.

OUT! TAKEN! Dinesh Chandimal holes out and Fayyaz Ahmed has the last laugh! Short ball, outside off. Dinesh Chandimal looks to pull but it goes off the top edge and the ball goes high into the night sky. Ayaan Khan at deep square leg settles under it and takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Ayaan Khan b Fayyaz Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! BOOM! Banged in short, yet again, around off. Dinesh Chandimal stays back and pulls it way over deep square leg for a maximum!
Another short ball, around off. Pathum Nissanka miscues his pull and the ball goes to the deep square leg fielder. A single taken!
Short ball, outside off. Dinesh Chandimal runs it down to third man for a run.
Fayyaz Ahmed comes into the attack now.
Swing and a miss! Banged in short, outside off. Pathum Nissanka slashes hard but he misses.
Back of a length, on off. Dinesh Chandimal defends it to cover and takes a single.
Good-length ball, around off. Pathum Nissanka taps it to point and takes off for a quick run.
Length ball, angling in from middle. Pathum Nissanka turns it to mid-wicket.
Good-length ball, around off. Pathum Nissanka blocks it out.
FOUR! GLORIOUS! Length ball, around off. Pathum Nissanka carves it handsomely through covers for a boundary.
Who will bowl from the other end? Bilal Khan it is.
Back of a length, around off. Dinesh Chandimal makes room and cuts it to the cover fielder. 11 runs off the over!
SIX! WOW! Dinesh Chandimal is making his intentions pretty clear here! Length ball, in the slot, around middle. Chandimal smokes it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
FOUR! BANG! Good-length ball, on middle. Dinesh Chandimal skips down and pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Lovely delivery! Good-length ball, outside off. Dinesh Chandimal looks to poke at it but he misses.
Sri Lanka are underway! Back of a length, on middle and leg. Pathum tucks it to the leg side and takes a quick run.
Good-length ball, on off. Pathum defends it to cover.
